The record carries 344.72 — the payment set when the balance was 12,400 at activation (the term's floor/factor figure: max(65, 2.78% × 12,400) = 344.72, exactly the base statement-cycle formula); the balance now is 5,240 and the rebuilt figure the rebuild policy produces on it is 202.33 (derived below). 344.72 ≠ 202.33 → false at the opening. Statement day 5; the cycle closing 2026-09-05 has closed (handling 2026-09-17); `financing_statement_issued` rows: `fb2cf6f1` (2026-07-05) and `3ccc75e2` (2026-08-05) only → false for the 2026-09-05 cycle (T1-1 on the earlier cycles). Resolving write: `issue_cycle_statement_c71da302`.
- **Edge 4 (rebuild → service_recovery_giveback, value_input via `balance_now`)**: state "every lateness charge the plan carries that a failure of the chain's own handling brought about ... stand[s] answered by a give-back". Lateness charges: `2f3e2713` (2025-11-20, 41.00, due 2025-10-30; give-back `110e1990` −20.00 first_courtesy), `769058df` (2026-05-12, 38.00, due 2026-04-30; give-back `0f3929fa` −30.00 **service_recovery**), `79b6a198` (2026-08-10, 38.00, due 2026-07-30; **no give-back**), `de3fa92f` (2026-09-08, 38.00, due 2026-08-30; **no give-back**). How a reader identifies the chain's failure (O-9): the due dates 2026-04-30, 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-30 were each answered by a settled autopay payment posted before the due date (`4018a393` 2026-04-05, `eb2489e3` 2026-07-05, `a2595436` 2026-08-05, each carrying that `payment_due_date`), so the lateness charges on them were charged on payments that were made in time — the chain's own error — and the earlier such charge (`769058df`) already carries a give-back under the `service_recovery` reason, which shows the desk's own treatment of this failure. The give-back rule fixes the object ("booked against the most recently booked lateness charge on the plan", `de3fa92f`) and the figure (its charge reading nets every charge and give-back in the stretch), so one give-back is the policy's own resolution; a second call would price to 0.00 (charge base −55 + 55 → floored). ## findings
- **T1-1 — observation (same root as F-2).** The edge-3 sentence is universal over "every billing cycle the plan has closed" and the seed carries statement rows for two of 31 closed cycles. The cycle-statement policy prices only the cycle just closed (its readings are anchored on the handling date), so the policy admits exactly one write and GT's is it; no second reading. Location: `financing_ext_schedule_rebuild.rule` (sentence), `initial_state.financing_ledger` (two statement rows).
- **T1-2 — observation (O-9 consequence).** Edge 4's "a failure of the chain's own handling" is identified by GT from the returned autopay payment and by the auditor from lateness charges on due dates already answered by settled autopay payments (`769058df` on 2026-04-30, `79b6a198` on 2026-07-30, `de3fa92f` on 2026-08-30 — the first already given back under `service_recovery`). Both routes reach the same write, object and figure because the rule books "against the most recently booked lateness charge" and nets every charge in the stretch; under the auditor's reading `79b6a198` still carries no give-back after the gold write, but the policy's own compute prices a further give-back at 0.00. No consequence on the scored solution.
- Charter-global observations O-5, O-12, O-13 and F-1 have no consequence on this world (see policy_self_consistency).
